notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Gilpin County Fair in Black Hawk, Krystal Meyer, and record a May 2026 call/message followed by talking with Krystal and sending information by email. Gmail confirms Amy followed up after Kristy spoke with Krystal. Source: handwritten call notes, page 82; Adventure Zone Gmail.
